headline: Baku Thursday Practice: Antonelli and Mercedes take to Baku street circuit
whyCareReason: Formula 1 takes to the Baku City Circuit for Thursday practice ahead of Saturday's Grand Prix. Kimi Antonelli defends an 81-point lead as Mercedes leads the constructors.
teaser: Thursday 24 September: FP1 and FP2 underway. Qualifying Friday, Grand Prix Saturday 26 September. Championship leader Antonelli 292.
story:
Why this one matters: Madrid is in the books. Baku is alive. Formula1.com lists a rare Thursday-Saturday race weekend at the Baku City Circuit (6.003 km, 51 laps) to observe Sunday's Remembrance Day.

Thursday practice opens with FP1 and FP2 navigating the high-speed Caspian seafront straight and the tight castle corners. Formula1.com and Sky Sports show qualifying set for Friday 1 p.m. UK and the Grand Prix Saturday 12 p.m. UK.

Drivers' standings entering Azerbaijan: Kimi Antonelli leads on 292 points, George Russell on 211, Lewis Hamilton on 191, Lando Norris on 186, and Charles Leclerc on 167. Mercedes leads the constructors' championship with 503 points.
stakes: A Saturday race on a street circuit, with an 81-point lead that has not been tested in Azerbaijan.
rivalryAngle: Mercedes versus the rest, on a track that rewards the long straight and punishes the castle section.
